rule: Renderer code may use labels and layout microcopy, but default business narrative, TOC, closing, captions, and industry fallback sentences must come from this file or industry packs. Chinese decks localize all non-essential visible microcopy; preserve only brand names, URLs, emails, tickers, and standard acronyms.
